title: Let your users buy a phone number through your app
summary: Give each customer their own project and API token, then search, buy, route and release phone numbers with their credentials rather than yours.
scenario: Your customers pick a local number during signup and give it back when they cancel

folds: round 7 gap: space and number management over REST for apps that provision per customer (Eric, 2026-09-03)
evidence: tools/openapi/rest.json POST /api/projects: name required; POST /api/project/tokens: name and permissions required, subproject_id optional; Project.TokenPermission enum of eleven includes numbers and management

tools/openapi/rest.json GET /api/relay/rest/phone_numbers/search query areacode, number_type, max_results...; POST /api/relay/rest/phone_numbers requires number; PUT and DELETE /api/relay/rest/phone_numbers/{id}; AvailablePhoneNumber requires number

sdk rest/client.py:63-77 RestClient(project, token, host) builds its own HttpClient with basic auth; rest/namespaces/phone_numbers.py search, and CrudResource create/update/delete with _update_method PUT
